frame: measurements/frame.json; x = temple long axis (+x east), y = +north, z up

origin.note: south-west corner of cell (0,0) in frame units

kNote: scan counted as metric (|k-1| <= 1% and CI contains 1); heights/positions are raw scan units = metres. The scan is non-rigidly distorted (see REPORT.md): expect decimetre-level errors away from the temple.
method: per-cell lowest dense 0.3 m layer (median) of splats with opacity > 0.2 and max scale < 1.5 (>= 4), 5x5 median outlier cut 0.5 m, IDW fill of the footprint and of holes within 5.0 m
encoding: terrain.png: uint16 grey, 0 = no data, z = zMin + (v-1)/65534*(zMax-zMin); row 0 = north edge (max y), column 0 = west edge (min x)
